mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jutsu_title WHERE info_fetched_at IS NULL OR info_fetched_at < #{watermark}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jutsu_title ( slug, site_id, title, original_title, synopsis, thumbnail_url, year_bucket, genres_csv, types_csv, catalog_episode_count, catalog_movie_count, info_total_seasons, info_total_episodes, info_fetched_at, catalog_fetched_at, first_seen_at, last_seen_at ) VALUES ( #{title.slug}, #{title.siteId}, #{title.title}, #{title.originalTitle}, #{title.synopsis}, #{title.thumbnailUrl}, #{title.yearBucket}, #{title.genresCsv}, #{title.typesCsv}, #{title.catalogEpisodeCount}, #{title.catalogMovieCount}, #{title.infoTotalSeasons}, #{title.infoTotalEpisodes}, #{title.infoFetchedAt}, #{title.catalogFetchedAt}, #{title.firstSeenAt}, #{title.lastSeenAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE site_id = COALESCE(VALUES(site_id), site_id), title = VALUES(title), original_title = COALESCE(VALUES(original_title), original_title), synopsis = COALESCE(VALUES(synopsis), synopsis), thumbnail_url = COALESCE(VALUES(thumbnail_url), thumbnail_url), year_bucket = COALESCE(VALUES(year_bucket), year_bucket), genres_csv = COALESCE(VALUES(genres_csv), genres_csv), types_csv = COALESCE(VALUES(types_csv), types_csv), catalog_episode_count = COALESCE(VALUES(catalog_episode_count), catalog_episode_count), catalog_movie_count = COALESCE(VALUES(catalog_movie_count), catalog_movie_count), info_total_seasons = COALESCE(VALUES(info_total_seasons), info_total_seasons), info_total_episodes = COALESCE(VALUES(info_total_episodes), info_total_episodes), info_fetched_at = COALESCE(VALUES(info_fetched_at), info_fetched_at), catalog_fetched_at = COALESCE(VALUES(catalog_fetched_at), catalog_fetched_at), first_seen_at = COALESCE(first_seen_at, VALUES(first_seen_at)), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
